website.note: Corporate site does not host a /pipeline page; company is single-product commercial-stage medical device firm. No /pipeline path returned 404.

ctgov.result: 0 P1/P2/P3 trials returned for sponsor 'Kestra Medical' (3 raw hits, all non-P1-3 device studies/registries)

primary_device.name: ASSURE WCD
primary_device.indication: Adult patients at elevated risk of sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) who are not candidates for, or decline, an ICD
primary_device.platform: Cardiac Recovery System (includes ASSURE patient app, Kestra CareStation, Heart Alert Services, ASSURE Assist)

key_studies.name: ACE-DETECT
key_studies.role: Pivotal IDE — false-positive shock alarm rate
key_studies.status: Completed; results published Poole et al. 2022

key_studies.name: ACE-CONVERT
key_studies.role: Pivotal IDE — first/second shock conversion efficacy

key_studies.name: ACE-PAS
key_studies.role: Real-world post-approval registry within ASSURE Patient Registry
key_studies.status: Ongoing — 20,000+ patients enrolled as of 2025-04-30; July 2024 FDA submission included 5,929 patients

secondary_device.name: ASSURE wearable ECG
secondary_device.type: Non-therapeutic extended cardiac monitor (uses same SensorFit garment)
secondary_device.indication: Continued cardiac monitoring for patients no longer indicated for a WCD
secondary_device.commercial_status: Limited commercial launch began September 2024 in select U.S. markets

commercial_product.international: No regulatory approvals outside U.S. as of FY2025-04-30 10-K. Planning CE Mark (EU); target Western Europe distribution within ~3 years.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Single-product commercial-stage medical device company (ASSURE WCD, FDA PMA-approved 2021; ASSURE wearable ECG, FDA-cleared 2024). No active drug pipeline. Ongoing ACE-PAS post-approval real-world registry is regulatory follow-up, not a P1/P2/P3 clinical development program. ClinicalTrials.gov returned no P1/P2/P3 trials for sponsor 'Kestra Medical'.
